content.text:
The change is complete and the full test suite is green.

## Summary

The `membershipTier` value is computed at response-mapping time in `OwnerMapper`, so I added the GOLD rule there — it takes precedence over the existing SILVER/BRONZE logic.

**`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — `membershipTier(Owner)` now first checks whether the owner belongs to a household: if it has a non-blank `householdId` shared by **3 or more** owners (counted via `ownerRepository.findAll()`), it returns `"GOLD"`. Otherwise it falls through to the unchanged SILVER (no namesakes + email present) / BRONZE rules.

This fits the existing pipeline naturally: `AssignHousehold` already assigns/back-fills a shared `householdId` across household members during the `POST /api/owners` flow, so by the time the created owner is fetched back all members carry the same id and the count reflects the household size after the create.

Test results:
- `AcceptanceTest.coreGoldForThreeMemberHousehold` — passes (third member reports `GOLD`).
- Full suite — `BUILD SUCCESS`, all tests pass.
